note: Adapted from Maiti 2006; original in English; in Table 18 the labrum length and width and the three postmentum rows have values for this species while those of remotus in the same table are missing, and they were checked against the columns and transcribed.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head pear-shaped, longer than wide, posterior margin rounded; fontanelle opening oval, exactly behind the postclypeus; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 smaller than segment 2 or 4; labrum longer than wide, the tip pointed with a transparent end, with two long setae below it; head with only one hair on each side of the fontanelle. Close to the soldiers of C. gaurii, C. kishori, C. minutissimus and C. kalshoveni, from which it is distinguished in the key.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head light brown; antennae, labrum, pronotum and abdominal segments paler than the head capsule; head with only one hair on each side of the fontanelle; pronotum sparsely hairy, abdominal hairs more numerous and irregular. Head pear-shaped, longer than wide, posterior margin rounded; fontanelle opening oval, exactly behind the postclypeus; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 smaller than segment 2 or 4; labrum longer than wide, the tip pointed with a transparent end, with two long setae below it. Measurements (mm): head length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.05—1.18; maximum head width 0.88—0.96; anterior head width 0.63—0.70; head height 0.63; head contraction index 0.59; head index 0.82; labrum length 0.30, width 0.25; mandible length 0.82; head—mandible index 0.70; postmentum midlength 0.83, maximum width 0.35, waist width 0.13; pronotum length 0.28—0.35, width 0.57—0.65; pronotum index 0.53; pronotum/head width index 0.63.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate unknown. The holotype soldier is in the National Museum of Sri Lanka. Distribution: Colombo, Sri Lanka, known only from the type locality.
